purpose: Refresh local Business Central Playwright auth shell validation for playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before rerunning the D31 VAT Assisted Setup read-only discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: auth:bc:target confirms the redacted target URL points to playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
agent:run-plan lists auth:bc:target before auth:bc:doctor, auth:bc:check or any BC workflow.
auth:bc uses a local ignored persistent Playwright profile for attended Login/MFA retries.
auth.setup writes TARGET-027D31-AUTH-result.json on success or failure.
npm run auth:bc:doctor is used as fast go/no-go before a long auth refresh retry.
Shell validation metadata matches playthru and UNIVERSAARL-DE.
The success signal comes from the Playwright auth browser context, not from a normal Chrome/Codex app login.
No login page is accepted as Business Central evidence.
If auth is refreshed, rerun only the D31 read-only Assisted Setup / Manual Setup discovery.
No setup, VAT value, master data, draft, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut occurs.
stopIf: Auth remains on login.microsoftonline.com or any non-Business-Central shell.
Shell validation environment is not playthru.
Shell validation company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Any flow asks to confirm setup or write data before D31 read-only evidence is captured.

latestAttempt.learning: A normal browser login is not sufficient for target workflows; the Playwright auth browser must reach the Business Central shell and auth:bc:check must be green.

latestAuthSetupResultWriter.helperBehavior: sets process.exitCode=1 after writing result evidence instead of rethrowing the raw Playwright timeout
latestAuthSetupResultWriter.operatorAction: Complete Login/MFA in the Playwright-opened browser window until Business Central shell is visible; normal Chrome login is not enough.

latestAuthPersistentProfileImprovement.improvement: auth:bc now uses a local persistent Playwright profile at playwright/.auth/bc-profile so Microsoft Login/MFA progress can survive repeated auth attempts.

latestAuthTargetDiagnosis.conclusion: Local source URL still comes from the legacy MCP environment, but auth target construction rewrites it to playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before opening Playwright.

latestAuthContextGate.improvement: agent:context now exposes authGate.operatorActionRequired=true, target playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE, the latest auth result path, blockedBy and the next safe Playwright-window sign-in action without running BC or Playwright.
latestAuthContextGate.nextSafeAction: Run npm run auth:bc:interactive, complete Login/MFA in the Playwright-opened browser window until Business Central shell appears, then require npm run auth:bc:check canUseStoredAuth=true before D31.

nextStep: Run npm run auth:bc:interactive when ready to complete Login/MFA in the Playwright-opened browser window, then run npm run auth:bc:check and require canUseStoredAuth=true.

latestAuthProbe.improvement: Short attended Playwright auth probe added so stale-login detection can complete in about 30 seconds instead of repeating the full 10-minute auth wait.
latestAuthProbe.nextSafeAction: Run npm run auth:bc:interactive, complete Login/MFA in the Playwright-opened auth window until Business Central shell is visible, then require npm run auth:bc:check canUseStoredAuth=true.

latestAuthRedirectDiagnosis.improvement: Auth shell diagnosis now records redacted loginRedirect information from the Microsoft sign-in URL, so wrong-target suspicions can be checked without exposing secrets.
latestAuthRedirectDiagnosis.conclusion: The current page is still Microsoft sign-in before BC shell; the redirect points to Business Central remote sign-in, not a proven playthru shell. Environment/company remain unproven until auth:bc:check is green.

latestAuthInteractiveCommand.improvement: Added a long attended Playwright auth command for manual Login/MFA, separate from the short auth probe and the standard auth command.
latestAuthInteractiveCommand.nextSafeAction: Run npm run auth:bc:interactive when ready to complete Login/MFA in the Playwright-opened browser window, then run npm run auth:bc:check and require canUseStoredAuth=true.
